pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many joints does a descant recorder have? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Three
   C. Five
   D. Six

2. Good feedback should be (1 mark)
   A. kind, honest, specific and helpful
   B. only criticism
   C. rude and short
   D. only praise with no reasons

3. Which is an improvised glue? (1 mark)
   A. Flour paste
   B. Salt water
   C. Engine oil
   D. Paint thinner

4. In a glide, your arms are (1 mark)
   A. folded
   B. behind your back
   C. by your sides
   D. stretched above the head with palms together

5. When playing an animal game, you should play on (1 mark)
   A. sharp stones
   B. soft, clear ground
   C. thorn bushes
   D. broken glass

6. Which is part of pool hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Wearing dirty clothes
   B. Not showering
   C. Not passing urine or spitting in the pool
   D. Eating in the pool

7. A relay race is a race in which (1 mark)
   A. people throw a ball
   B. team members take turns running and pass a baton
   C. one person runs all the way
   D. people jump into sand

8. Which are instrumentalists in a folk song? (1 mark)
   A. The umpire
   B. The audience
   C. People playing drums or shakers
   D. Dancers only

9. Who can teach you an indigenous game from your community? (1 mark)
   A. Only a computer
   B. A stranger online
   C. Nobody
   D. An elder

10. On the staff, the note B sits on (1 mark)
   A. line 5
   B. line 3
   C. line 2
   D. line 1

11. What is the length of a full netball court? (1 mark)
   A. 100 metres
   B. 50 metres
   C. 10 metres
   D. 30.5 metres

12. How many verses does the Kenya National Anthem have? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. One
   C. Two
   D. Three

13. Which of these letters has a tail below the baseline? (1 mark)
   A. d
   B. y
   C. h
   D. l

14. Which is a patriotic song? (1 mark)
   A. A lullaby about sleeping
   B. Kenya National Anthem
   C. A drum solo
   D. A hymn of worship only

15. After painting, how should you store a brush? (1 mark)
   A. Under a heavy book
   B. Covered in paint
   C. Standing on its hairs in water
   D. Washed and laid flat or with hairs upwards

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What is a side roll? (2 marks)

17. What does it mean to improvise a rhythmic pattern? (3 marks)

18. Why is it important to keep the right posture during a sprint? (3 marks)

19. What is a sequence in gymnastics? Give an example. (3 marks)

20. Give one example of a melodic percussion instrument and one non-melodic percussion instrument. (2 marks)

21. What is stepwise motion? Give an example. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Three
   Head joint, middle joint and foot joint.

2. A — kind, honest, specific and helpful
   Good feedback helps the person improve.

3. A — Flour paste
   Flour mixed with water and heated water makes a paste.

4. D — stretched above the head with palms together
   Arms overhead create a streamlined shape.

5. B — soft, clear ground
   Soft, clear ground prevents injuries.

6. C — Not passing urine or spitting in the pool
   Keeping the pool clean matters.

7. B — team members take turns running and pass a baton
   In a relay, runners pass a baton to the next teammate.

8. C — People playing drums or shakers
   Instrumentalists play instruments.

9. D — An elder
   Elders know many traditional games.

10. B — line 3
   B is on the middle line.

11. D — 30.5 metres
   A full court is 30.5 metres long and 15.25 metres wide.

12. D — Three
   The anthem has three verses.

13. B — y
   The letter y has a tail below the baseline.

14. B — Kenya National Anthem
   The anthem is a patriotic song.

15. D — Washed and laid flat or with hairs upwards
   Washing and shaping the tip keeps the brush in good shape.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: A roll along the mat sideways with the body straight and long like a log.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sideways roll, 1 mark for the straight body.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: To make up a pattern on the spot without writing it first, using an instrument such as a drum or shaker to keep to the beat of a song.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for making up on the spot, 1 mark for no writing first, 1 mark for using an instrument.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the body moving forward in a straight line. It saves energy and helps speed. It prevents pain or injury.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: A set of movements done in a fixed order. For example crab balance, lower to the mat, lie straight, side roll.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for the correct example.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Melodic: xylophone. Non-melodic: shaker, kayamba or claves.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct example.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Moving from a note to the next note above or below. For example, d to r.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
